speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Nightmare Disorder

Those frightening episodes with recollection of bad dreams and temporary tiredness after waking are classic signs of nightmares, not the kidney infection you were asked to suggest. I have requested a sleep history assessment and a home video recording to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other sleep disorders.
